sloka: स्थूलाक्षः पट्टिशम् गृह्य प्रमाथी च परश्वधम् ।दृष्ट्वा एव आपततः ताम् तु राघवः सायकैः शितैः ॥३-२६-१९॥
transliteration: sthūlākṣaḥ paṭṭiśam gṛhya pramāthī ca paraśvadham ।dṛṣṭvā eva āpatataḥ tām tu rāghavaḥ sāyakaiḥ śitaiḥ ॥3-26-19॥

translations.english: On seeing them rushing to attack him with sharp weapons, Rama received them quickly with pointed arrows as though they were guests.
